<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

The Awtsmoos brings many sparks into one ordered path; Awtsmoos.com will be refined only after the live vessel is measured, then rewritten whole, tested whole, and released without wrath.
-->
# Final Pre-Code Plan

1. Finish prior release proof and cleanup.
2. Capture current live mobile screenshot/DOM geometry and computed style evidence.
3. Inspect the exact current Create markup and late-loaded style modules from deployed SHA.
4. Choose the smallest whole-file touch set.
5. Rewrite all touched files completely; create small CSS modules instead of inflating old ones.
6. Add one browser regression for visual fragmentation, unified deck geometry, focus state, reduced motion, and overflow.
7. Run syntax, file-size, diff, deterministic, and all browser regressions.
8. Re-read every touched file and compare PLANNED vs ACTUAL.
9. Reconcile newest `origin/main` race window.
10. Commit only intended Olam paths, fast-forward push, exact-SHA canonical deploy.
11. Verify public HTTP, Chrome, production SHA/service.
12. Clean temporary worktrees/processes and write final evidence.
